title: Guti UHC Addon
description: A plugin that improves the experience using the UHC Playground Plugin.
body:
GutiUHCAddon is an expansion plugin for UHC Playground that enhances and speeds up the UHC experience.

⚠️ UHC Playground and its dependencies are required.

This addon is designed for faster, more dynamic games, inspired by Mindcrack UHC Rush, while also making game management easier for operators.

**Key Features:**

- Dynamic World Border: Configure a moving border that gradually shrinks and finishes at a specific radius within a defined time. (/faststart to start the shrinking)

- Custom GUI Items:
  - Note Block item to open GutiUHCAddon configuration.

- Double Health Balance: Customize the amount of resistance given when double health is enabled in UHC Playground, avoiding the default Resistance II if desired.

- Shiphon: You can configure a siphon option, so when you kill someone you get healed the number of hearts you chose.

- Loot start: Create, save and load loot pools, so you can give the loot to all the players with /giveloot
 
- Extra options to customize gameplay and improve match flow.


Perfect for servers looking for faster UHCs, better control, and a smoother setup experience.
